description: The Cisco Aironet Access Points deliver the versatility, high capacity and enterprise-class features required for small, medium and large Government indoor and outdoor wireless deployments. In FIPS 140-2 mode of operation, the Cisco APs support the IEEE 802.11i and IEEE 802.1x standards and AES for WPA2 encryption.
